preregistration_notice: This document freezes the complete evaluation plan for the selected Phase 7 hypothesis BEFORE any untouched-history outcome has been computed or viewed. Per the Part 11 coverage_manifest.json finding (completed immediately before this file, using only calendar-coverage bookkeeping against already-frozen manifests -- no hypothesis-specific or strategy-outcome data of any kind), zero genuinely untouched, currently-fetchable R_75 history exists. This plan is preregistered in full regardless, exactly as it would have been executed had sufficient untouched history existed, so that its own minimum-sample stopping rule (Part 13 below) is what formally concludes this study, rather than an ad-hoc abandonment. It will not be edited after this point; any future attempt to run it must be a new, separately versioned experiment_id.
exact_single_change: Reject a setup the parent engine would otherwise mark TRADE_READY if stop_distance_atr > 3.975, where stop_distance_atr = abs(entry - stop) / mean(high - low) over the trailing 14 completed M5 candles up to and including the decision candle.

threshold_definition.derivation: Q4/Q5 quartile cutpoint of stop_distance_atr computed once over the full 1,093-setup Phase 5 consumed distribution (data/stabilization/phase7/postmortem/diagnostic_buckets.json). Fixed at preregistration time; never adjusted after this point regardless of any future outcome.

primary_metric: conservative-cost mean realized R (net_r_conservative_cost), grouped by structural_episode_id, on the retained (variant-eligible) population of the untouched-history candidate universe.

cost_model.version: phase5-conservative-cost-v1 (unchanged from Phase 5, per preregistration discipline -- costs are never lowered after seeing a result)

fill_policy: Identical to Phase 5 -- setup.entry at the first completed M5 candle where decision.trade_ready == true (data/stabilization/phase5/preregistration/experiment_spec.json -> entry_policy), unchanged.

fold_schedule.rule: Chronological walk-forward folds over the genuinely untouched candidate window only, purge and embargo applied identically to the Phase 5 fold-construction method (data/stabilization/phase5/manifests/fold_manifest.json).

control_definitions.paired_opposite_direction: Same event, direction flipped, symmetric geometry -- unchanged construction from Phase 5.
control_definitions.random_direction: At least 1,000 deterministic seeded permutations (validation.strategy_feasibility.control_methodology_v2.deterministic_random_direction_permutations), finite-sample p-value (same module).
control_definitions.parent_vs_variant: Both the unfiltered parent strategy and the variant-filtered population are evaluated on the identical untouched-history candidate universe; the variant is always a subset of the parent's eligible setups.

grouping_method: structural_episode_id (matches Phase 5's grouping unit for the primary CI).

minimum_sample.stopping_rule: If the genuinely untouched candidate universe cannot produce at least the minimums above for BOTH the parent-eligible population and the variant-retained population, stop with RESEARCH_EXTENSION_REQUIRED_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (or RESEARCH_EXTENSION_REQUIRED_INSUFFICIENT_UNTOUCHED_HISTORY if the underlying calendar coverage itself is inadequate, as already determined in Part 11) without computing or reporting any hypothesis-specific outcome statistic.

direction_requirements: Both BUY and SELL must be represented in the retained population; a verdict is never issued from a single-direction sample.
drawdown_limit: Maximum drawdown on the retained population must not exceed the parent's own drawdown scaled proportionally to the retained sample size, and must be reported regardless of pass/fail.
acceptance_gates_in_order: CAUSALITY (zero future-data violations, zero setup-ownership violations)
POST_COST_PERFORMANCE (conservative-cost expectancy > 0, grouped lower-95 > 0, profit factor > 1.0)
IMPROVEMENT_OVER_PARENT (variant-minus-parent expectancy positive, grouped lower-95 of the difference > 0, drawdown not worse)
maximum_allowed_verdict: ELIGIBLE_FOR_SECOND_INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION -- never PRODUCTION_READY, LIVE_READY, AUTO_ELIGIBLE, PAPER_ELIGIBLE, CONFIRMED_PROFITABLE, or GUARANTEED_EDGE under any outcome.

untouched_data_boundaries.genuinely_untouched_window_identified: 2026-04-20T23:59:00Z to 2026-04-21T05:45:00Z (5.77 hours) -- the only calendar time outside every excluded/embargoed window as of this preregistration's timestamp
untouched_data_boundaries.conclusion_carried_forward: RESEARCH_EXTENSION_REQUIRED_INSUFFICIENT_UNTOUCHED_HISTORY, per Part 11, applies to this preregistered plan before any evaluation step (Parts 14-17) is attempted.

second_holdout_policy.applies_when: A future Phase 7 extension accumulates enough newly-elapsed, non-embargoed calendar time (via natural passage of time and/or restored Deriv connectivity) to meet minimum_sample.
second_holdout_policy.policy: If a development-style evaluation on that newly available window passes every gate above, a further, separate, sealed holdout slice (never opened during development, opened at most once, following the exact discipline of data/stabilization/phase5/holdout/holdout_manifest.json) must be defined and preregistered before any development-window outcome is computed, mirroring Phase 5's own holdout discipline. This file does not itself define that holdout's dates, since insufficient calendar time exists yet to schedule one meaningfully.

no_changes_after_outcomes_are_viewed: This file is immutable from this point forward. Any correction, extension, or re-scoping is a new experiment_id, never an edit to this one.
